item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】ALAC - Billie Eilish - HIT ME HARD AND SOFT: THE TOUR (LIVE) |Vinyl Rip 24bit / 88.2kHz
item.description:
Credits to the original DSD Vinyl Rip by grandemaiale

This is my own ALAC conversion/master made from the original DSD source. I edited and reworked the concert to make the entire show play seamlessly from start to finish.

The result is a nonstop listening experience where every track naturally moves into the next without cuts, gaps, or abrupt jumps, almost like a continuous performance.

I made sure to preserve the quality of this masterpiece as much as possible, that's why it's 2500-3000kbps.
